sections.instruction: Complete the sentences for each situation. Use the word given + the ending -ING or -ED:

questions.prompt: The film wasn’t as good as we had expected. (disappoint-) a) The film was [gap]. b) We were [gap] with the film.
Diana teaches young children. It’s a very hard job but she enjoys it. (exhaust-) a) She enjoys her job but it’s often [gap]. b) At the end of a day’s work, she is often [gap].
It’s been raining all day. I hate this weather. (depress-) a) This weather is [gap]. b) This weather makes me [gap]. c) It’s silly to get [gap].
questions.explanation: weather causes it (-ing); people feel it (-ed)
